weeklyReview.question: Where has your life been taking shape lately?
weeklyReview.focusWithLayers: Your actions have mostly landed in {layers}.
weeklyReview.focusEmpty: No clear focus has formed yet. Let your real records keep settling in.

stateDescriptions.DATA_SETTLING: Your record is still taking shape. Let the rhythm appear a few more times before defining growth.
stateDescriptions.FOCUSED_ROOTING: A small number of layers are appearing consistently, so this period looks more like focused rooting.
stateDescriptions.MULTI_LAYER_GROWTH: Several layers have left traces across weeks, and life is opening up in more than one place.
stateDescriptions.RECONNECTING: Some earlier rhythms are connecting again without needing to return at full strength all at once.
stateDescriptions.QUIET_SETTLING: There are fewer action traces right now. This is better understood as a settling period, not regression.

weeklyReview.evidenceEstablished: Real actions appeared in {connected} layers, and {established} of them show continuity across weeks.
weeklyReview.evidenceSettling: Real actions appeared in {connected} layers; the evidence is still settling in.
weeklyReview.evidenceEmpty: There are not enough behavior traces yet to describe a focus.
weeklyReview.journeyDescription: This looks beyond a single score to whether actions keep appearing across different weeks.
weeklyReview.weeksConnected: Across the past 12 weeks, {connected} of {eligible} planned weeks left a connection.
weeklyReview.runContinues: The connection has continued through the latest {count} planned weeks.
weeklyReview.runSettling: The recent rhythm is still reconnecting.
weeklyReview.noTrack: No observable path has formed across the past 12 weeks yet.
weeklyReview.noJourneyYet: There are not enough traces across weeks yet. Keep recording honestly; you do not need to prove growth early.
weeklyReview.nextDescription: A small direction for the rhythm you have now, without asking every layer to be filled.
weeklyReview.keepWithLayer: Keep the current minimum action for {layer}; there is no need to raise the bar.
weeklyReview.keepFallback: Let honest records continue before adding another expectation.
weeklyReview.gentleWithLayer: Leave one light connection in {layer} and let the rhythm find its way back gradually.
weeklyReview.noGentle: Nothing needs to be filled in right now. Holding your current rhythm is enough.
weeklyReview.basisNote: This describes a behavior process, not a total score or a comparison of which life layer is better.

fullRecord.title: View all layer records
fullRecord.description: Expand to review 30-day connections, stage trends, and 12-week paths across {count} layers.

growthMatrix.title: Layer Growth Matrix
growthMatrix.description: See how your actions take root across life layers over the past 30 days and settle into rhythm across 12 weeks.
growthMatrix.basisText: Connections come from your recorded behavior. Planned opportunities and historical trends use the current plan as a stage estimate.
growthMatrix.historyIncomplete: No; long-term trends are stage estimates
growthMatrix.equalWeightNote: The 30-day connection score is calculated for each item first, then combined with equal weight so high-frequency items do not dominate a layer.
growthMatrix.sharedItemsNote: Stage trends only compare items with planned opportunities in both 30-day periods.
growthMatrix.cohortTitle: Items included in each layer's stage comparison
growthMatrix.weekLegend: Week cells: solid means connected, light means planned with no connection recorded, and dashed means no plan that week.
growthMatrix.currentRun: Connected across the latest {count} consecutive planned weeks
growthMatrix.noCurrentRun: The latest planned week has no connection record yet
growthMatrix.noEligibleWeeks: No continuous path has formed in the past 12 weeks

radarChart.title: Layer Connection Overview
radarChart.description: Expand to see the shape of connection across layers over the current 30 days.
radarChart.disclaimer: This view only shows the current distribution of layer connection. It does not imply that every layer needs equal investment or indicate which layer is growing faster. A layer without a plan is not treated as a zero score.

energyPanel.title: Energy context from the past 7 days
energyPanel.description: Use the past 7 days of energy states to understand when micro-actions or restorative rest made sense.
energyPanel.detailIntro: Low energy micro-actions and intentional rest are both recognized as legitimate progress. Here is the distribution for this week:
energyPanel.levelHighSub: Energized state, deep execution of planned actions
energyPanel.levelNormalSub: Sustainable standard actions, solidifying system foundation
energyPanel.levelLowSub: 3-minute minimum viable action, preserving connection (not failure)
energyPanel.levelRestSub: Active recharge for body and mind, preserves continuity
energyPanel.unloggedNotice: Plus {count} days with unlogged energy; unlogged represents unknown and is not mapped to any tier.

dynamicTemplates.defaultConnection: You maintained a continuous connection with your life operating system this week.
dynamicTemplates.lowEnergy: Across {lowDays} low energy days this week, you still completed {lowActions} micro-actions to preserve your long-term connection.
dynamicTemplates.rest: You scheduled {restDays} intentional rest days, allowing your system to recharge peacefully.
dynamicTemplates.habit: You completed {habitCount} positive actions this week, steadily moving forward in your rhythm.
dynamicTemplates.quit: You maintained mindful self-awareness on reduction goals for {quitDays} days this week.
